topic: elephant seismic communication through ground vibrations
reusable_mechanics: behavior mystery in the first second

continuity_bible.subject_identity: one adult African savanna elephant with a small triangular notch in the right ear, intact tusks, natural proportions, dust on lower legs
continuity_bible.environment: the same dry East African savanna clearing with one fallen acacia branch at frame left and distant low hills
continuity_bible.lighting: warm dawn light from camera right with long soft shadows and light ground haze
continuity_bible.color_treatment: natural earth tones, warm restrained highlights, soft blue-gray distant hills, documentary contrast
continuity_bible.screen_direction: the elephant faces or moves right-to-left; vibration energy travels left-to-right toward the elephant
continuity_bible.camera_language: grounded wildlife documentary, long-lens observation mixed with motivated ground-level macro views, no impossible drone dives

factual_notes.claim: Elephant calls can generate seismic vibrations that propagate through the ground.
factual_notes.source_title: Exploring the Potential Use of Seismic Waves as a Communication Channel by Elephants and Other Large Mammals

factual_notes.claim: Research indicates elephants can detect and distinguish information in ground-borne vibration signals.
factual_notes.source_title: Stanford Medicine — African elephants communicate by ground vibration

factual_notes.claim: The feet are a plausible initial interface for detecting seismic signals, with more than one sensory pathway proposed.
factual_notes.source_title: Seismic Communication in Elephants — research explainer

source_phrases_for_originality_check: listening with their feet to vibrations in the ground
generate similar acoustic and seismic vibrations

script_segments.narration: This elephant may be listening to a message you cannot hear, through the ground.
script_segments.caption: A MESSAGE BENEATH ITS FEET
script_segments.visual_action: The same elephant abruptly pauses mid-step beside the fallen acacia branch and lowers its weight onto the front feet
script_segments.entry_action: Begin on a low ground-level view as the right front foot settles into dust
script_segments.exit_action: End with the elephant completely still, right ear notch visible, facing left
script_segments.camera: Ground-level 85mm documentary close shot, gentle forward creep
script_segments.ambience: Continuous dawn savanna wind, distant birds, very low insect bed

script_segments.narration: A deep rumble does not travel only through air. Some energy enters the soil as vibration.
script_segments.caption: RUMBLE → GROUND VIBRATION
script_segments.visual_action: Long-lens profile of the same elephant producing a subtle low rumble; dust grains near the feet tremble almost imperceptibly
script_segments.entry_action: Continue from the still listening pose, maintaining right-to-left orientation
script_segments.exit_action: End tilting down toward the right front foot and vibrating dust
script_segments.camera: Stable 135mm side profile, slow tilt from head to feet
script_segments.ambience: Same savanna bed with a restrained sub-bass rumble
script_segments.sfx: Natural low rumble without cinematic boom

script_segments.narration: The signal can move across the landscape while the receiving elephant stands completely still.
script_segments.caption: THE GROUND CARRIES IT
script_segments.visual_action: Macro ground view travels from a distant dust ripple past cracked soil toward the same elephant foot; no glowing fantasy waves
script_segments.entry_action: Enter on the vibrating dust from shot two
script_segments.exit_action: End when the subtle ripple reaches the planted front foot from frame left
script_segments.camera: Low tracking macro parallel to the ground, left-to-right energy movement
script_segments.ambience: Continuous wind and birds with faint earth resonance

script_segments.narration: Sensitive feet and body pathways can help turn that vibration into useful information.
script_segments.caption: FEET DETECT THE SIGNAL
script_segments.visual_action: Close view of the same planted foot and lower leg, then a restrained anatomical overlay traces a plausible pathway upward without labeling certainty
script_segments.entry_action: Continue exactly as the ripple reaches the front foot
script_segments.exit_action: Overlay fades while camera rises toward the elephant's attentive head
script_segments.camera: Documentary close-up transitioning to a slow vertical rise
script_segments.ambience: Same continuous environment under a subtle tactile pulse
script_segments.sfx: Quiet low-frequency pulse synchronized to the arrival

script_segments.narration: Studies suggest elephants can distinguish information in these signals, including who produced a call.
script_segments.caption: THE SIGNAL CARRIES IDENTITY
script_segments.visual_action: The same elephant lifts its head and turns slightly toward a distant off-screen herd; ear notch and lighting remain identical
script_segments.entry_action: Enter as the camera rise reaches the attentive eye
script_segments.exit_action: End on the elephant holding its gaze toward frame left
script_segments.camera: Long-lens close portrait with a gentle motivated pan left
script_segments.ambience: Continuous savanna bed; distant low rumble arrives before picture settles

script_segments.narration: When a herd suddenly pauses, the conversation may already be beneath them.
script_segments.caption: A CONVERSATION UNDERFOOT
script_segments.visual_action: Wide dawn view reveals two distant herd silhouettes while the same foreground elephant remains still beside the fallen acacia branch
script_segments.entry_action: Continue the elephant's gaze direction into the wide landscape
script_segments.exit_action: Hold the quiet tableau for a clean half second as dust moves through warm light
script_segments.camera: Slow pullback to a wide grounded wildlife composition
script_segments.ambience: Savanna ambience opens wider and the low rumble fades naturally
script_segments.sfx: No impact; end on environmental sound
